text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking in the park, I ran into Mejiro Ramonu.
A little girl was following behind her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Who knows... A lost child, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: *sob*... Mommy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The little girl tightly grasped the hem of Mejiro Ramonu's clothes.
It seemed she had taken a liking to her.
Ramonu-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What happened?
...Who is this child?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Dober, perfect timing.
I leave this child in your care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Her parents... well, they must be nearby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, wait...!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: *gasp*! Big sister, don't leave me, nooo...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... Ramonu-san is looking
for your mommy.
So let's wait here with me.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: Nooo... I wanna stay with that other big sister... *sob*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Is she scared of me...? 
Well, of course she would be...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(But Ramonu-san entrusted her to me,
so I have to look after her properly.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I need to be careful with my tone and facial expression...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hey there, what kinds of things do you like?
I'd love it if you could tell me.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Play dances... 
We danced them at nursery school...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Play dances? Wow, I want to see!
Hey, pretty please? Could you dance for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wiping away her tears, the girl nodded
and clumsily showed her dance to Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! You're so good!
Then, can you do choreography like this?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, I can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must have been happy being praised by Mejiro Dober.
The little girl eagerly began copying her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That was wonderful!
Hey, can we dance together some more?
choice_data_list: Big brother wants to dance too.
Big sister wants to dance too.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text: Look, look! How was that dance?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Super cute!
Well then, what dance should we do next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, Mejiro Ramonu returned,
bringing a woman who appeared to be the mother.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mommy!
Listen, listen! With big sister and the others,
we danced a whole lot and had so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I see, you had fun.
...Um, thank you so very much for taking care of her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No, I'm just truly glad she was able to safely reunite with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mother and child bowed and left the park.
The little girl kept waving to Mejiro Dober until she was out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Dober, you are quite skilled with children.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I look after my younger brothers often,
so I'm used to playing games and dancing with them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was confused at first, but...
I'm really glad that child cheered up.
